units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 9:20">Targ. Y. Gen. IX, 20</cite> <he>דמושכיה נהרא וכ׳</he> (read: <he>דמַשְׁכֵיה</he>) which the river had carried along from &c.—
<cite ref="Zevachim 53b">Zeb. 53ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>מַשְׁכוּ גברי לגברא</he> the many brought the single man over (to their opinion).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 27b:8">Ab. Zar. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>שאני מינות דמָשְּׁכָא</he> it is different with heresy, because it attracts (persuades, offers inducements).

senses.gloss: (neut. verb) מְשׁךְ, מְשִׁיךְ to run in a continuous line; to be prolonged, continued.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 21:35">Targ. Y. Num. XXI, 35</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 54b:5">Ber. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>מַשְׁכֵי שיניה</he> his teeth were prolonged.
<cite ref="Horayot 12a:13">Hor. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>כי היכי דמַשְׁכוּ מיא מַשְׁכָן וכ׳</he>. as the water runs continually, so may the traditions which you teach be continued.

<cite ref="Horayot 12a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>אי משיך נהוריה</he> (Rashi <cite ref="M02878"><he>משיך</he></cite>) if the light continues to burn; <cite ref="Keritot 5b:116">Ker. 5ᵇ</cite>.—[<cite ref="Keritot 5b:116">Ib.</cite> <he>משכו שתא</he>, read: <cite ref="M01929"><he>מסיק</he></cite>.]—
<cite ref="Pesachim 8a:5">Pes. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>משיך נהוריה</he> the light (of a lamp or a candle) burns steadily, opp. <he>מיקטף איקטופי</he>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 2b:11">Ab. Zar. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>משכי במלכותייהו</he> they will continue their rulership; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 316">Yalk. Is. 316</cite> <he>משכה מלכותייהו</he>; a. e.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 48a:10">B. Mets. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>עד דמָשֵׁיךְ</he> until he takes possession; <he>עד דמשך</he> until he has taken &c. Ib. 49ᵃ <he>מַשְׁכֵיה</he> he has taken possession of it; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Megillah 31a:7">Meg. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>משך תורא</he> ‘take possession of the ox’ (mnemotechnical words to designate the order of Scriptural readings on the Passover days, ref. to <he>משכו</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 12:21">Ex. XII, 21</cite>; <cite ref="U01054"><he>שור</he></cite>, <cite ref="Leviticus 22:26">Lev. XXII, 26</cite> &c.).

senses.gloss: to be attracted, carried away, seduced. Ab. Zar. l. c. דאתי למִמְּשַׁךְ בתרייהו he may be induced to follow them (the heretics).
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 70a:11">Snh. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>משום אִימְּשׁוּכֵי הוא</he> it is in order to prevent being carried away (led to intemperance); <he>לא מִימְּשִׁיךְ</he> he will not be carried away (it has no attraction for him); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 929">Yalk. Deut. 929</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 147b">Sabb. 147ᵇ</cite> <he>אי׳ בתרייהו</he> he was drawn after them, he indulged in the luxuries of the place; a. fr.
<cite ref="Pesachim 78b:11">Pes. 78ᵇ</cite> <he>אי מִמְשְׁכֵי הני וכ׳</he> if these should withdraw (from their participation in the Passover sacrifice), it would remain fit for the others.
